features.description: AGUIProvider: hadTokenOnceRef + first-load-only gating so token refresh doesn't unmount children
acceptance_criteria: hadTokenOnceRef ref tracks whether we've ever resolved a non-null token
Loading-branch return is gated on (!tokenResolved && !hadTokenOnceRef.current) — only blanks on the very first load
Token-refresh effect path does NOT call setTokenResolved(false) when hadTokenOnceRef.current is true
Existing cancellation pattern (let cancelled = false; cleanup) is preserved
HttpAgent's useMemo([skillId, token, sessionId]) still rebuilds when token changes
Sign-out path (user becomes null) still clears the token and re-engages the gate
features.notes: 11 LOC: useRef import + hadTokenOnceRef declaration + first-load-only gating in two effect branches + render-gate guard. All 6 acceptance criteria met. Existing 4 AGUIProvider tests pass unchanged.

features.description: Vitest: stable-token user-ref change does not unmount; HttpAgent IS rebuilt on token change
acceptance_criteria: New vitest case: simulate a `user` reference change with token unchanged → assert children stay mounted (a child component's render count does not increment from unmount+remount)
New vitest case: token actually changes → assert HttpAgent IS rebuilt (new HttpAgent instance reference)
No request goes out without an Authorization header (assert via fetch mock log)
features.notes: 3 new test cases (no-unmount, agent-rebuild-with-new-token, first-load-still-gates), 110 LOC including hoisted vi.mock helpers (authStateCallback + currentToken). All 7 AGUIProvider tests now pass (4 original + 3 new).

features.description: Defensive vitest: useSessionMessages does not refire its GET on provider re-render without sessionId change
acceptance_criteria: New vitest case in useSessionMessages.test.ts: render hook, trigger a re-render with same sessionId → fetch mock called exactly once across the whole lifecycle
features.notes: 1 new defensive test case (34 LOC). All 11 useSessionMessages tests pass.
